Sodium hypochlorite and ammonia are metered into the filter effluent at the head of four serpentine chlorine contact channels to produce a solution of chloramines for disinfection. As the effluent leaves the contact channels, its chlorine residual is measured, and an appropriate amount of sodium bisulfite is added to neutralize the hypochlorite.
